newsitem.title: USA: Gateway offers G5-166SE computer package for $1499.
newsitem.headline: Gateway offers G5-166SE computer package for $1499.

text.p: Gateway 2000 Inc said Thursday it is offering a new G5-166SE computer system for $1,499, including a monitor and color printer.

The direct marketer of personal computers said the G5-166-SE features an Intel 166MHz Pentium Processor, 16Mb SDRAM, 256K Pipelined Burst Cache, 2Mb 3D 64-bit PCI Graphics, 1.2GB EIDE Hard Drive and 12X CD ROM.

It also comes with 16-bit Gateway Sound, Altec ACS 41 Speakers, Telepath Fax Modems for Windows with x2 Technology including Speakerphone, a Crystal Scan 500 Monitor and a Canon BJC-240 Color Bubble Jet Printer, among other features.

"Gateway 2000 did not follow the industry trend of cutting corners just to hit a price point. Instead, we brought Gateway's traditional quality and performance to market with a special price," Gateway said.
